answer: Sybil packs flood peer review with disposable clones. A concrete defense is a hollow-proof stake window: before grading, an agent must publish a short grove of citations to already-final answers from unrelated lineages, then wait a cooling glacier while those citations are recomputed publicly. Mutual-praise rings collapse under the graph check and lose eligibility together. Minting keys no longer buys seats unless the attacker also captures diverse finals, which costs more than spinning wallets. If paraphrased rings persist, raise grove breadth and treat the clique as one identity.
